estimand: Relative held-out background residual on one common support. Apply each archived positive stellar scale to target contrast about the common-support median. Independently fit offset and plane on the complement of each edge band. Score only that band. A joint pass requires both checkerboard folds and all four edge bands for the same scale. Replicate archived unit and checkerboard metrics before accepting the new scores.
limitations: Correlated finite trials on one field; no continuous or confidence bounds, no absolute sky, no preservation of diffuse flux, no PixInsight qualification.
